instruction.name: AESENC128KL
instruction.copyright: Copyright (C) Intel Corporation. All Rights Reserved.
instruction.shortdesc: Perform Ten Rounds of AES Encryption Flow With Key Locker Using 128-Bit Key

para.string: Further details on Key Locker and usage of this instruction can be found here:

instruction performs ten rounds of AES to encrypt the first operand using the 128-bit key indi­cated by the handle from the second operand. It stores the result in the first operand if the operation succeeds (e.g., does not run into a handle violation failure).
ZF is set to 0 if the operation succeeded and set to 1 if the operation failed due to a handle violation. The other arithmetic flags (OF, SF, AF, PF, CF) are cleared to 0.

programlisting.string: AESENC128KL unsigned char _mm_aesenc128kl_u8(__m128i* odata, __m128i idata, const void* h);
